title: End-Semester Winter Examination 2026 Schedule
description: The final timetable for the End-Semester Theory and Practical Examinations has been published. Hall tickets will be available for download on the student ERP portal from October 20.

title: Campus Recruitment Drive: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)
description: TCS Digital and Ninja recruitment drive registrations are now live. Eligible candidates having CGPA >= 6.5 with zero active backlogs must register before October 18.

title: Practical Lab Journal & Term Work Submission Deadline
description: All enrolled students must get their continuous evaluation journals signed and verified by respective lab in-charges before the term end date. Late submissions will attract grade deductions.

title: Annual Inter-College Tech Fest 'Cognizance 2026' Registrations
description: Calling all innovators and coders! Registration portal is open for Hackathons, Robot Wars, Paper Presentations, and Web Design Competitions with prize pool exceeding ₹1,50,000.

title: Diwali Vacation and Institutional Holiday Calendar
description: The university campus and academic departments will observe Diwali break from October 28 to November 05. Regular instructional classes will resume on November 06.

title: Mid-Semester Remedial and Improvement Exam Notification
description: Students seeking to improve internal assessment scores or those who missed exams on valid medical grounds must submit remedial forms along with requisite verification documents.

title: Infosys Springboard Certification & Internship Opportunity
description: Complimentary access to Infosys Springboard industry certificates in Cloud Computing, AI, and Full-Stack Engineering with direct fast-track interview tracks for top scorers.

title: Central Library Book Return & Zero-Penalty Drive
description: Return all overdue library circulation books between October 5 and October 15 to avail of a complete waiver on overdue fines prior to semester clearance.

title: Hostel Fee Payment Deadline Extension for Term 2
description: Upon student council representations, the deadline to deposit semester hostel accommodation and mess charges has been extended until October 15 without late fee charges.

title: Google Cloud Career Practitioner (GCCP) Program Kickoff
description: Join the official orientation for Google Cloud Career Practitioner pathway. Hands-on labs on Google Cloud Skills Boost with exclusive swags and certification vouchers.

title: Mandatory Anti-Ragging Affidavit Submission
description: As per UGC directives, all newly enrolled students must submit the online anti-ragging affidavit reference number on the college portal immediately.

title: NPTEL & SWAYAM Credit Transfer Course List
description: Approved list of 12-week NPTEL MOOC courses for MOOC elective credit transfer (3 credits) for the upcoming academic session has been released.

title: Pre-Placement Soft Skills & Aptitude Boot Camp
description: Intensive 40-hour boot camp covering Quantitative Aptitude, Logical Reasoning, Mock Group Discussions, and Technical Interviews commencing next Monday.

title: National Science Day Inter-University Model Exhibition
description: Submit working hardware models and software prototypes on themes of 'Sustainable Energy and AI for Humanity'. Seed funding grants awarded to top 5 innovative prototypes.

title: Student Grievance Redressal Portal Launch
description: A centralized digital ticket system has been inaugurated to streamline student requests regarding academic records, fee receipts, transport, and campus facilities.

title: Blood Donation & Health Check-up Camp by Red Cross
description: Join hands for the annual voluntary blood donation drive at College Gymnasium from 10:00 AM to 04:00 PM. Donors will receive certificate and donor credit cards.

title: Winter Semester Course Registration & Elective Selection
description: Online course registration window for Winter Semester 2027 is now open on the ERP portal. Students must finalize elective choices by November 10. Late registrations will not be entertained.

title: Wipro TalentNext Scholarship Program Applications
description: Wipro TalentNext is accepting applications for its annual merit scholarship of ₹25,000 per annum. Shortlisted candidates also receive guaranteed interview calls for Wipro Elite roles.

title: NBA Accreditation Peer Team Visit — Campus Preparation
description: The NBA peer review committee will visit on November 20-22. All departments must ensure lab readiness, attendance records, and project portfolios are updated and available for inspection.

title: Annual Prize Distribution & Academic Excellence Ceremony
description: The Annual Convocation and Prize Distribution ceremony will be held at the Convention Centre. Merit rank holders, best project awardees, and sports champions will be felicitated.

title: Inter-College Robotics Expo Team Registrations Open
description: Registrations are officially open for Robowars, Line Follower, and Maze Solver events. Team size is limited to 4 members. Hardware kits will be allocated on a first-come basis.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup Student Mentorship Cohort 2027
description: Selected student teams will receive 1-on-1 mentorship from Microsoft senior engineers, Azure cloud credits up to $1,000, and fast-track interviews for Microsoft summer internships.

title: Final Submission Window for Major Project Synopsis
description: All capstone project teams must upload their finalized project synopsis, system architecture diagrams, and guide approval certificates on the portal by November 30.

title: Campus Wi-Fi Infrastructure Upgrade Maintenance Notice
description: High-speed Wi-Fi 6 access points will be deployed across Academic Blocks and Hostels on Saturday midnight. Intermittent connectivity is expected from 12:00 AM to 04:00 AM.

title: Special Supplementary Examination Timetable Declaration
description: Detailed schedule for the Special Supplementary Examination has been published. Eligible students must submit examination forms along with fee challans before December 05.

title: Seed Funding Grant of ₹5 Lakhs for Student AI Startups
description: Applications are invited for the Student Entrepreneurship Grant 2026-27. Top 3 AI and CleanTech student startups will receive prototype grants, co-working space, and patent filing support.

title: Google Student Developer Club (GDSC) Core Team Applications
description: GDSC is recruiting core team leads for Web Development, Machine Learning, Cloud, and Event Management tracks. Interested students should submit their GitHub and LinkedIn profiles.

title: Late Fine Penalty Waiver on Pending Tuition Fee Payments
description: The Finance Committee has announced a special 10-day window from December 10 to December 20 waiving all late submission penalties on semester tuition fee balances.

title: Amazon AWS Academy Cloud Certification Scholarship Window
description: 100 complimentary exam vouchers for AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner and Solutions Architect Associate exams will be awarded based on mock assessment performance on December 18.

title: Hostel Room Allotment Rules for Upcoming Academic Session
description: Room reallocation guidelines, biometric check-in policies, and night curfew timings for the upcoming semester have been revised. Download the handbook from the university intranet.

title: Semester Grade Improvement & Photocopy Application Form
description: Students wishing to obtain assessed answer script photocopies or apply for grade verification must fill out the Exam Cell Form 4 within 15 days of result declaration.

title: Guidelines for Paper Submissions in CHARUSAT Tech Journal
description: Call for research papers for Vol. 14 of the CHARUSAT Journal of Technology. Selected high-impact papers will be forwarded for Scopus indexation with zero publication fees.

title: Annual Sports Meet 'Athlos 2026' Trial Schedule
description: Department selection trials for Cricket, Football, Basketball, Badminton, and Table Tennis will be held on the university grounds between January 04 and January 08.

title: Accenture Innovation Challenge 2026 Shortlisted Teams
description: Hearty congratulations to the 6 student teams from Computer Engineering and IT shortlisted for the National Semifinals of Accenture Innovation Challenge. Mentorship boot camp begins Monday.

title: Mid-Term Academic Progress Reports Sent to Parents via ERP
description: Consolidated midterm reports showing subject-wise attendance percentages, internal assessment marks, and mentor remarks have been dispatched via SMS and ERP portal.

title: Cyber Security Awareness Month & Phishing Simulation Drill
description: Do not share OTPs or ERP login credentials. An unannounced ethical phishing simulation will be conducted across campus mailboxes to evaluate cybersecurity hygiene.

title: Foreign University Student Exchange Program (Summer 2027)
description: Applications are invited for a 6-week summer research internship at partner universities in Germany, Canada, and Singapore with partial travel scholarships.

title: Notice Regarding Mandatory 85% Minimum Lab Attendance Rule
description: Strict compliance with 85% minimum practical laboratory attendance is mandatory to be eligible for end-semester practical examinations. Defaulter lists will be finalized by month end.

title: Deloitte Graduate Technology Internship Assessment Dates
description: Deloitte USI online technical coding and analytical aptitude assessment will be hosted in Computer Centers 1, 2, and 3 this Saturday from 10:00 AM sharp. Bring college photo ID.

title: Winter Vacation Library 24x7 Reading Room Extended Hours
description: In view of GATE, GRE, and civil services examination preparation, the Air-Conditioned Central Reading Room on the 2nd Floor will remain accessible 24 hours a day with biometric security.
